selection_status: Retrospective selection after inspecting legacy outputs; additional B/C seeds fixed before their execution. Not preregistered.

A.legacy_chunk_size_provenance: Not recorded in historical CSV/JSON; 200000 is the current CLI default, not a verified historical parameter.
A.single_seed_provenance: 42 reported by user and matches current CLI default; historical single-run JSON does not record the seed.

B.tie_breaking: pandas nlargest(6, p1), default keep=first; original feature rows ordered by number ascending

C.sensitivity_scope: Reference seed 42 only; main configuration replicated across seeds 0..9

reporting.sd: Sample standard deviation across runs, ddof=1
reporting.range: Observed min and max across runs; not a confidence interval
reporting.C_relative_effect: Compute relative increase within each population, then report mean, sample SD, min and max across 10 populations; do not pool agents
reporting.seed42: Separate reference illustration, excluded from repeated B/C aggregates
